description: Memory-tight Candidate single-Spark image-to-video recipe using Wan 2.2's scaled-FP8 high/low-noise experts. Its declared 118 GB startup peak plus 8 GB system reserve leaves only 2 GB on a 128 GB Spark, so it is not the default and must pass a physical OOM canary before recommendation.
title: Wan 2.2 I2V 14B ComfyUI single Spark
